messages:
jen: Heads-up: production alerts for eu-west1 embeddings spiking after staged rollout of quant-v2-lite. Several customer requests timed out. Need a quick hotfix.
sam: saw that too. graphs show p95 ok but p999 jumping. No node OOMs.
lucas: is this across host types or just dedicated pool?
jen: dedicated eu pool only. Reduced throughput on short-context (<=128 tokens). Link: https://grafana/redwood/eu/embeds/alerts
anya: if it's model perf, we should pin alias to quant-v1 and stop the canary traffic. That avoids restarting infra.
deploybot: auto: canary summary for quant-v2-lite in eu-west1 -> increased tail latency 4x, error rate +0.2%. Suggested remediation: alias pin OR rollback canary.
sam: approvals needed to bypass canary: ENG x2 + OPS. I can approve. lucas?
lucas: approve from ENG.
jen: ops-bot, will pin require draining pods or will it be traffic switch only?
ops-bot: ops-bot: This action updates model routing alias. No pod restarts. Slight KV cache invalidation for in-flight requests. Expect transient ~500s for <45s.
jen: perfect. running command (via deploybot):
```
/deploybot pin-model --alias eu-embed-default --model quant-v1 --region eu-west1 --force --reason "hotfix: quant-v2-lite tail latency regression"
```
deploybot: queued by jen. awaiting required approvals (eng:2, ops:1).
sam: ops signoff from me granted.
deploybot: approvals satisfied. executing pin...
deploybot: success: alias eu-embed-default -> quant-v1 (eu-west1). change_id: ch_3640012345_pin. propagation ~18s.
anya: watching metrics now.
jen: p99 looks back to baseline ~210ms. p999 settling at ~400ms. No spike in 5xx.
lucas: nice.jen please create a short release note and link PR.
jen: making PR now: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/912 (draft). Title: "eu embeddings: revert to quant-v1 after quant-v2-lite latency regression".
sam: schedule: pause further canaries for quant-v2-lite until perf tests + post-mortem.
ops-bot: calendar: postmortem with eng-ml + infra tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Invite sent.
jen: filing issue and assigning to @eng-ml perf team. Will include perf traces and sample requests.
anya: leave canary paused and set alert threshold lower for next rollout.
jen: thanks everyone, monitoring for 30m then will close. :thumbsup:
